items.notes: Reports historical workload totals and units; does not discuss partition keys, hot-key skew, or adding partitions.
Describes producer and auditor count reconciliation; no treatment of offset reset or retention expiry.
Landing-page link list for Java/runtime topics; no time-series rebucketing or wide-ID content.
Covers PostgreSQL index families and planner costs, not range versus hash partitioning or its write/query exposure.
Quorum arithmetic for voters concerns fault tolerance, not replica write capacity behind one authoritative shard.
Message-store migration outcomes; search-shard outage gaps are only cross-referenced, not explained.
Defines Recall@k against judged relevant items, but does not address incomplete judgments or their effect.
Explains basic inverted-index mechanics; silent on document revisions that never coexisted.
Synthetic metrics-cardinality failure; no Uber query-tier quota or storage-operation pricing.
Supports class separation and priority/cap to protect core work, but does not cover avoiding indefinite starvation of lower classes.
